scope: ZP-01 step 1: one identical offline bundle resource for both native applications; no OTA schema or release activation.

coverage: four exact external source URLs without unsupported reader routes
closed nested consumer allowlist excludes draft/evidence fields
deterministic sole bundle file matches checked-in bytes

native_handoff: Copy only exports/ten-commandments-v1/ten-commandments.json into each application bundle and compare this exact SHA. No generated timestamps or platform-specific rewrites.
id/revision are stable local content identity, not a new remote package version. S12 active content and OTA media remain unchanged.
Summary attribution and explanatory note stay separate from full biblical attribution to Đura Daničić. No clerical review is claimed.
EXO/DEU reference objects are bibliographic only; the complete EXO excerpt is embedded. Do not pass these references to the existing Gospel reader or invent a deep link.

Sources retain four exact HTTPS URLs. Existing source titles/translators get mechanical Latin counterparts. Two sources have no approved localized title, so display their URL or host rather than technical id; no new editorial wording was invented.
Exporter is idempotent only for identical bytes and rejects a different existing export. All draft, approval, prior validation and private helper fields stay outside the runtime directory.
